prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE ATLAS, not a design board, with TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Use the three reference images ONLY for the approved animal identities and final torso costumes, in the exact warm dark-brown thick outline, bright cel-shaded compact chibi art style of 桃园小英雄. No text, no background, no labels, no humans riding the animals, no hero heads, no weapons, no shadows. Exact rectangular uniform grid SIX COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, landscape 3:2, evenly spaced cells, generous transparent margins. Each cell is isolated, NEVER overlapping neighbors.
ROW1 six animation frames of the SAME cute WHITE HORSE from reference1: normal short pointed HORSE ears, silver-white mane/tail, grey hooves, compact round body/short sturdy legs, small jade forehead charm and green/gold saddle cloth. Must not be donkey/rabbit. Head/body stays registered to same position and scale across row. Frames columns1-6: idle standing; trot left diagonal legs forward; trot passing; trot right diagonal legs forward; trot passing alternate; dash compressed forward gallop. Three-quarter side view facing RIGHT in every frame, no different view angles. SAME horse anatomy and proportions in all frames. Saddle empty, no rider/reins/people.
ROW2 same SIX poses/registration of the compact RED HORSE from reference2: orange-red mane/tail, short normal horse ears, dark hooves, jade/gold forehead guard and green saddle cloth; same round short-legged style. Empty saddle, no rider.
ROW3 same SIX poses/registration of the compact ROUND DARK BROWN BOAR from reference3: broad pink snout, tiny ivory tusks, short spiky mane, bright expressive eyes, stubby legs, modest brass forehead guard, plum-purple saddle blanket/red strap. Body warm charcoal-brown not a black silhouette. Empty saddle, no rider. Same head/body anchor across all frames, only leg/ear/tail movement.
ROW4 column1 ONLY a HEADLESS/ARMLESS/LEGLESS empty chibi SHORT HERO TORSO garment from final Liu Bei reference1: ivory-emerald-gold short robe, peach-shaped green clasp/red waist sash, small green/red-lined cape. Column2 ONLY matching final Guan Yu torso from reference2: jade-white/emerald-gold compact light armor, red waist sash/short cape. Column3 ONLY final Zhang Fei torso from reference3: purple-scarlet-gold compact light brawler armor, small tiger buckle/red sash/short red cape. Torso drawings front view, truly no heads/hands/feet/arms, short bean bodies with easy-to-composite neck opening. Columns4/5/6 of row4 remain COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT EMPTY. Do not add extra armor accessories in those empty cells.
Atlas art must be crisp, consistent shapes, low detail readable at 80-130 game pixels, no glow effects, no realistic animal anatomy, no long legs, no outlines around grid, no floor/ground, no watermarks, true alpha transparency.
